follow-up time: From before 22 weeks gestation until July 2019
outcome: Preterm birth between 22 weeks and 36 weeks 6 days of gestation
cohort: 1351 women with singleton pregnancies in France
finding: This cohort study found no association between endometriosis and preterm birth, and the disease phenotype did not appear to alter the result.
gest_age: 22 weeks and 36 weeks 6 days of gestation
